chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin eite in i zaksa thute panin kinkhia lo paikhiat loh nading, lungsim takpi tawh kidophuai hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, vantungmite tungah thu hong piakna kipin om a, zuih khialhna leh thungaih lohna apawl apawlte in thuak ding a kilawm thukhenna thuak uh ahih leh, a kipat cil a, Topa in hilhin, kam a za mite in a hong kipsak uh a lian mahmah gupna thudon loin om lehang, mawhna daan tawh bang ci kipelh ding i hi hiam?

Tua teci a pang mite tawh Pasian in lim tawh ahi zongin, a lamdang nate tawh ahi zongin, nalamdang tuamtuamte tawh ahi zongin, ama deihna bang a hawmsak Kha Siangtho piak thupha tawh ahi zongin teci a pang khawm hi.
Eite in i hilh a nung ciangin a piang ding leitung in vantungmite nuai-ah a koih kei hi.
Lai Siangtho khat sungah mi khat in: “Na lungngaih nadingin mi in bang hi lel ahi hiam? A en dingin na hong pai nadingin mihing tapa in bang ahi hiam?
Amah vantungmite nuai-ah a neukha na nuaikhiat zo hi, Amah minthan’na leh pahtawina na khusak hi. Na khut-a na pian’sakte na uksak a,

Na khempeuh ama khe nuai-ah na koih zo hi,” ci-in teci a pang hi. Na khempeuh a koih zo hi a cih ciangin a koih loh a om lai khat beek a om kei hi. Tu hunin na khempeuh ama khe nuai-ah a koihna i mu nai kei hi.

Tu-in ahih leh, vantungmite nuai-ah neukha bek niamkhiatna a thuak mi Zeisu in Pasian’ hehpihna hangin mi khempeuh taang dingin sihna a thuak nading thu sang ahih ciangin, minthan’na leh pahtawina a ngahna thu i thei hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ta tampite vanglian nopsakna-ah a khak nadingin, tua mite’ gupna a piangsakpa in gimna a thuakna hangin kicin’na a tun’ nadingin na khempeuh bawl a, a uk Pasian in a kilawm hi.
A siangthosak theipa leh siangthona a ngah mite in innkuan khat pan a piang uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in amaute, “Ute naute aw,” ci-in sap ding a maizumpih kei hi.
Tua bang a cihna in: “Ka ute ka naute kiangah Na min ka gen ding hi, Mihon laizangah nangmah phatna la ka sa ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Mun khat panin, “Pasian ka muang ding hi,” a ci hi. Khatvei leuleu: “Kei-a kipan Pasian hong piak tate a om uh hi,” ci-in a kigen hi.

Tua hi a, tua tate in a si a sa tawh kizom uh ahih ciangin Khazih in zong sihna a thuak ciangin, Dawimangpa ahi sihna a ukpa a suksiat nading ahi zongin, sihna kihta ahih manunah a nungta lai takun a tawntungin a kikhum bangin a omte a suahtak sak nadingin ahi zongin, tua tate bangin si-le-sa a la hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in a man takin vantungmite a huh kei hi; Abraham’ suante a huh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah in mite mawhna tang ding Pasian tawh kipawl nate ah hehpihna tawh ahi zongin, dikna tawh ahi zongin a dim Siampi Ukpa a suah nadingin, a u a naute tawh a kibat taktak nading thu a om hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amahmah in ze-etna thuakin gimna thuak ngei zo ahih ciangin ze-etna a thuakte a huh nadingin a siam hi.
